entities.name: Árpád Duka-Zólyomi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Árpád Duka-Zólyomi was a Hungarian nuclear physicist, university teacher and politician from Slovakia. He was deputy of National Council from 1992 to 2004 and Member of the European Parliament with the Party of the Hungarian Coalition, part of the European People's Party, from 2004 to 2009.

entities.summary: Árpád Duka-Zólyomi was a Hungarian nuclear physicist, university teacher and politician from Slovakia.
